messages:
alex_support: FYI - ACME (acme-123) on dedicated pool rp-42 started getting 429s ~2026-03-15 09:12PT after we migrated their plan yesterday. Customer says embeddings and short chat calls both failing. Sending quick logs below.

alex_support: logs: `2026-03-15T09:12:03Z level=warn tenant=acme-123 pool=rp-42 code=429 reason=quota_exceeded quota_key=plan:acme-prod unit_type=requests remainder=0`

alex_support: sample response headers from curl: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 120
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reason: per_tenant_quota`

maya_sre: can you paste the request example you repro with (curl or SDK) and the plan id they were migrated to?

alex_support: curl attached: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" -d '{"model":"embed-32k","input":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings`

alex_support: plan id is `acme-prod-v2` (migration job id 2026-03-14-20).

derek_eng-dedicated: I glanced at plan-mapper change rolled 03/14. New code sets a default unit_type when plan annotation missing. Looks like for some plans defaulted to `requests` instead of `tokens`.

maya_sre: confirmed in debug: `plan=acme-prod-v2` quota blob shows `{"limit":120,"unit_type":"requests","window_seconds":60}` but their old plan used `{"limit":120000,"unit_type":"tokens","window_seconds":60}`. That explains embedding calls being counted as one request each instead of many tokens.

oncall-bot: incident created INC-2026-03315-01 - high 429s for acme-123 on rp-42 (linked to plan-mapper).

sam_billing: if we need a quick customer-facing fix we can temporarily raise the per-tenant request limit for acme-123 or mark their plan as tokens until patch lands. Which is easier short-term?

derek_eng-dedicated: short-term: set explicit quota override on tenant (apply unit_type=tokens, multiply limit * 1000) so embedding calls behave. Longer: patch plan-mapper to preserve unit_type when plan migration happens. I can push hotfix now.

maya_sre: I ran a quick repro after applying a test override in staging: embeddings no longer 429 and token consumption aligns. Will run on rp-42 once dev confirms hotfix.

alex_support: I applied emergency override to acme-123 on rp-42 (temp_quota_unit=tokens, limit=120000) and informed customer. They report traffic back to normal.

customer-ops: thanks team - that fixed it for us. Please confirm any billing/usage delta will be visible.

sam_billing: noted - override will show up as manual quota adjustment on billing dashboard; I'll follow-up with accounting and flag for credits if needed.

derek_eng-dedicated: hotfix PR opened (#5234) to preserve `unit_type` on plan import + add a migration job to correct recently migrated plans. Rolling to canary now.

maya_sre: monitoring: keeping rp-42 under 1m window for 30m, will escalate if we see spillback throttles.

alex_support: summary for ticket: root cause = plan-mapper defaulted missing quota annotation to `requests` during migration, causing token-oriented workloads to hit request ceilings. Mitigation = tenant override applied, hotfix + migration queued. Customer back to normal.

customer-ops: appreciated, leaving note in their ticket that you will follow up with timeline for permanent fix. :thumbsup:
